bind_address.description: IP address to bind the listener socket to. Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

listen_socket.description: The [SRC]:PORT combination where redir listens for incoming connections.

remote_socket.description: The [DST]:PORT combination to which connections are redirected.

foreground.description: If true, runs in the foreground (-n). If false, detaches as a daemon.

use_syslog.description: If true, logs to syslog (-s). Default is true unless foreground is enabled.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level: none, err, notice, info, debug.

ident_name.description: Identity name for TCP wrappers and syslog messages (-I).

timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before closing a connection (-t).

max_bandwidth.description: Maximum bandwidth in bits/sec (0 for unlimited) (-m).

random_wait.description: Random wait time in milliseconds for traffic shaping simulation (-w).

buf_size.description: Buffer size in bytes for data transfer (-z).

ftp_mode.description: FTP handling mode: port, pasv, or both (-f).

transproxy.description: If true, enables transparent proxy mode (-p).

inetd.description: If true, runs in inetd mode (-i).

http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy address:port for CONNECT tunneling (-x).
